ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District and B3-3, Community Shopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 11-G in the area bound by:

      the alley next north of and parallel to West Leland Avenue; the alley next east of and
      parallel to North Winthrop Avenue; West Leland Avenue; the alley next east of and
      parallel to North Winthrop Avenue; a line 37.25 feet south of West Leland Avenue; North
      Winthrop Avenue; the alley next south of West Leland Avenue; the alley next west of
      North Winthrop Avenue; West Leland Avenue; and North Winthrop Avenue,

to those of a B2-5, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ___________________________
                                                         Angela Clay
                                                         Alderperson, 46th Ward




Common Address:
